result.detail: Any customer with Manage Server can add a public bot/app with no Discord review. Docs: "If marked as public, anyone with your bot's URL can add it to guilds in which they have proper permissions." Verification is only needed at 100+ guilds: the gateway docs say verification is "required for apps in 100+ guilds", and the OAuth2 docs say "Verified bots do not have a maximum number of guilds". OAuth2 user scopes such as identify and guilds need no approval. Only partner-only scopes do. Caveats: the 100 figure comes from the gateway doc phrase and from search snippets of the support-dev verification article and the 2020 policy. I couldn't read the article (403). The newer privileged-intent review is keyed to reach (about 10,000 users), so verify the current rule in the Developer Portal. Docs moved to docs.discord.com. I did not re-read the page for the quote myself, so it comes from a subagent's excerpt.
result.quote: For verified apps (required for apps in 100+ guilds), the intent must also be approved after the verification process to use the intent.
